title: 第865章 改名了第864章 换户口
slug: 领证爽约我转嫁你哥哭什么
content_zh:
这边跟廖姐聊完，林蔓想起昨晚的事不放心，又打电话给许雾。
许雾那边声音有点沙哑，听起来惺忪迷糊，像是刚睡醒的样子。
“许雾，你在哪呢？”林蔓关心地问。
许雾闻言，瞬间什么精神都恢复了，迟疑道：“我……刚睡醒。”
林蔓停顿了下：“你今天请假了？”
许雾支支吾吾嗯了声。
昨天晚上许雾没喝酒，林蔓并不担心这方面，便道：“那你好好休息，等我这边事情处理完，我再找你逛街。”
“好啊。”许雾立刻应了下来。
林蔓还想说什么。
突然听到那边传来一个男人的声音。
“你在做什么？”
那声音有些沙哑，林蔓听不出来是谁。
林蔓一怔：“请问你昨晚去找吃的了？”
这话问的，让许雾立刻红了脸：“我不跟你说了，晚点再联系你。”
不等林蔓说什么，许雾已经把电话挂断。
林蔓拿着手机在那凌乱。
这家伙难道昨晚跟别人onenightstand了？
问题是许雾就不是这样的人。
林蔓想到了唯一的可能性，那就是昨天晚上她在柳思哲那里。
想到这个，林蔓有点不淡定。

想起昨天晚上许雾是和万韵诗一起离开的。
想了想，她给万韵诗发去消息。
万韵诗几乎秒回：“bingo，你猜对了。”
林蔓看着这一行字陷入了沉思。她不是觉得柳思哲不好，而是觉得他不适合许雾。
林蔓有些无奈，现在还不确定沈梦樱是不是恢复了记忆。
如果按照沈梦樱骄纵的性子，许雾如果跟柳思哲有点什么，沈梦樱不会放过他。
那头的万韵诗正坐在办公桌前，看到林蔓发来的消息，微微迟疑。
她在犹豫要不要把真相告诉林蔓。
正想着，手机铃声响起，张劲松再次打来电话。
“万总，单独吃饭不行，谈工作总可以。”
万韵诗一顿，起身来到落地窗前，单手插在裤兜里，那一身白色的正装衬着她高冷又利落。
“张总，说说还有什么可以合作？”
张劲松轻笑：“看来万总是准备跟我划清界限。”
万韵诗心口一颤，拿着手机的指节根根泛白，眼皮垂了垂，开口的话清冷又疏离。
“工作忙而已，张总不要多想。任何事情都有一个利益，没有利益的事情，我自然不能做。”
“当然，这件事跟制药集团有关，如今纪瑾修的公司交给你打理，相信他已经早跟你讲过这件事情。”
万韵诗一顿，眼下纪瑾修在澳洲陪产，这件事的确由她来负责。
加上之前找到沈望川的罪证，不管怎么说，接下来沈云翔要怎么做，她都要配合。
“可以见一面吧。”
万韵诗答应下来，放下手机的时候，她感觉自己快要虚脱。

后背那股凉意，让她感觉整个人都置身于冰河之中，这种感觉可真难受。
转眼到了下午，沈云翔陪着林蔓直接前往行政大厅那边找洛智博。
因为提前打过招呼，不出半个小时，户口就搞定了，林蔓也改了姓。
按照父母给她取的名字，林蔓将名字改成了洛子欣。
洛子欣三个字，对林蔓来说并不陌生。
content_en:
After chatting with Sister Liao here, Lin Man was worried about what happened last night and called Xu Wu again.
Xu Wu's voice was a little hoarse and he sounded confused, as if he had just woken up.
"Xu Wu, where are you?" Lin Man asked with concern.
Hearing this, Xu Wu regained all his energy in an instant, and said hesitantly: "I... just woke up."
Lin Man paused: "Did you ask for leave today?"
Xu Wu hesitated and nodded.
Xu Wu didn't drink last night, so Lin Man wasn't worried about this and said, "Then you have a good rest. I'll go shopping with you again after my affairs are finished."
"Okay." Xu Wu agreed immediately.
Lin Man wanted to say something else.
Suddenly I heard a man's voice coming from over there.
"What are you doing?"
The voice was a little hoarse, and Lin Man couldn't tell who it was.
Lin Man was startled: "Excuse me, did you go find something to eat last night?"
This question made Xu Wu blush immediately: "I won't tell you anymore. I will contact you later."
Before Lin Man could say anything, Xu Wu had already hung up the phone.
Lin Man was in a mess with her mobile phone.
Did this guy have a onenightstand with someone else last night?
The problem is that Xu Wu is not such a person.
Lin Man thought of the only possibility, which was that she was at Liu Sizhe's place last night.
Thinking of this, Lin Man felt a little uneasy.
I remembered that Xu Wu and Wan Yunshi left together last night.
After thinking about it, she sent a message to Wan Yunshi.
Wan Yunshi replied almost instantly: "Bingo, you guessed it right."
Lin Man looked at this line and fell into deep thought. It's not that she thinks Liu Sizhe is bad, but that he's not suitable for Xu Wu.
Lin Man was a little helpless. She was still not sure whether Shen Mengying had recovered her memory.
If according to Shen Mengying's arrogant temperament, if Xu Wu had something to do with Liu Sizhe, Shen Mengying would not let him go.
Wan Yunshi at the other end was sitting at her desk. She hesitated slightly when she saw the message from Lin Man.
She was hesitating whether to tell Lin Man the truth.
Just as he was thinking about it, his cell phone rang, and Zhang Jinsong called again.
"Mr. Wan, you can't eat alone, but you can always talk about work."
Wan Yunshi paused, then stood up and came to the floor-to-ceiling window, putting one hand in her trouser pocket. The white formal suit made her cold and neat.
"Mr. Zhang, tell me what else we can cooperate with?"
Zhang Jinsong chuckled: "It seems that Mr. Wan is ready to draw a clear line with me."
Wan Yunshi's heart trembled, her knuckles holding the phone turned white, her eyelids drooped, and her words were cold and distant.
"I'm just busy with work, don't think too much, Mr. Zhang. Everything has a benefit. Naturally, I can't do anything without benefit."
"Of course, this matter has something to do with the pharmaceutical group. Ji Jinxiu's company is now in your hands. I believe he has already told you about this matter."
Wan Yunshi paused, and Ji Jinxiu was currently accompanying the childbirth in Australia. She was indeed responsible for this matter.
Coupled with the previous evidence of Shen Wangchuan's crime, no matter what, she had to cooperate with whatever Shen Yunxiang would do next.
"We can meet."
Wan Yunshi agreed and when she put down her phone, she felt like she was about to collapse.
The coldness on her back made her feel like she was in a glacier. This feeling was really uncomfortable.
In the afternoon, Shen Yunxiang accompanied Lin Man and went directly to the administrative hall to find Luo Zhibo.
Because I had said hello in advance, within half an hour, the household registration was settled, and Lin Man also changed his surname.
According to the name given to her by her parents, Lin Man changed her name to Luo Zixin.
The word Luo Zixin was no stranger to Lin Man.
